not_modelled.application_references_predicate: openFDA exposes no predicate identifier for 510(k) submissions, and the 510(k) summary documents were not collected. A predicate relation cannot be established from this data, so it is not invented.
not_modelled.manufacturer_of_device: the applicant field is a record claim, not proof of current manufacture. It is shown as the applicant, with its PRODUCT-002 attribution status, rather than modelled as a device relation.
not_modelled.record_mentions_device: every application record names a device by definition; emitting a relation for it would be tautological. The device name is shown on the record and on the device page instead.
